arxiv-2106-06818.title: Variable metric backward-forward dynamical systems for monotone inclusion problems
arxiv-2106-06818.creator: Pankaj Gautam, D. R. Sahu, J. C. Yao
arxiv-2106-06818.description: Abstract . This paper investigates first-order variable metric backward forward dynamical systems associated with monotone inclusion and convex minimization problems in real Hilbert space. The operators are chosen so that the backward-forward dynamical system is closely related to the forward-backward dynamical system and has the same computational complexity.

arxiv-2109-08873.title: Formulation and verification of gyrokinetic simulation of kinetic-MHD processes in toroidal plasmas
arxiv-2109-08873.creator: Xishuo Wei, Pengfei Liu, Gyungjin Choi, Guillaume Brochard, Jian Bao, Yuehao Ma, Haotian Chen, Handi Huang, Zhihong Lin 1
arxiv-2109-08873.description: Abstract A set of electromagnetic formulations with gyrokinetic ions and drift kinetic electrons for global gyrokinetic simulations has been formulated and verified in the framework of Gyrokinetic Toroidal Code (GTC), which is particularly suitable for the low-frequency electromagnetic modes including drift waves, Alvén Eigenmodes and MHD modes.

arxiv-2202-13666.title: Over-the-Air Computation with Imperfect Channel State Information
arxiv-2202-13666.creator: Yilong Chen * , Guangxu Zhu † , and Jie Xu *
arxiv-2202-13666.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yilong Chen * , Guangxu Zhu † , and Jie Xu *. This paper investigates the effect of imperfect channel state information (CSI) on the over-the-air computation (AirComp) system, in which multiple wireless devices (WDs) send individual messages to one access point (AP) for distributed functional computation. By particularly considering the channel estimation errors, we jointly design the transmit coefficients at the WDs and the receive strategy at the AP, for minimizing the computation mean squared error (MSE).

arxiv-2206-03443.title: V392 Persei: a 𝜸 \boldsymbol{\gamma} -ray bright nova eruption from a known dwarf nova 2022 V392 Persei: a 𝜸 \boldsymbol{\gamma} -ray bright nova eruption from a known dwarf nova – 10
arxiv-2206-03443.creator: F. J. Murphy-Glaysher, M. J. Darnley, É. J. Harvey, A. M. Newsam, K. L. Page, S. Starrfield, R. M. Wagner, C. E. Woodward, D. M. Terndrup, S. Kafka, T. Arranz Heras, P. Berardi, E. Bertrand, R. Biernikowicz, C. Boussin, D. Boyd, Y. Buchet, M. Bundas, D. Coulter, D. Dejean, A. Diepvens, S. Dvorak, J.
arxiv-2206-03443.description: Abstract V392 Persei is a known dwarf nova (DN) that underwent a classical nova eruption in 2018. Here we report ground-based optical, Swift UV and X-ray, and Fermi -LAT γ \gamma -ray observations following the eruption for almost three years.

arxiv-2210-16534.title: Improved Approximation Algorithms for Capacitated Vehicle Routing with Fixed Capacity
arxiv-2210-16534.creator: Jingyang Zhao, Mingyu Xiao
arxiv-2210-16534.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jingyang Zhao, Mingyu Xiao. The Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) is one of the most extensively studied problems in combinatorial optimization. According to the property of the demand of customers, we distinguish three variants of CVRP: unit-demand, splittable and unsplittable. We consider k k -CVRP in general metrics and general graphs, where k k is the capacity of the vehicle and all the three versions are APX-hard for each fixed k ≥ 3 k\geq 3 .

arxiv-2302-08177.title: K ∗ 0 K^{*0} meson production using a transport and a statistical hadronization model at energies covered by the RHIC beam energy scan
arxiv-2302-08177.creator: Aswini Kumar Sahoo, Md. Nasim, Subhash Singha
arxiv-2302-08177.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Aswini Kumar Sahoo, Md. Nasim, Subhash Singha. In this paper, we discuss the centrality and energy dependence of K ∗ 0 K^{*0} resonance production using ultrarelativistic quantum molecular dynamics (UrQMD) and thermal models. The K ∗ 0 / K K^{*0}/K ratios obtained from the UrQMD and thermal models are compared with measurements done by the STAR experiment in Au+Au collisions at s N ​ N \sqrt{s_{NN}} = 7.7, 11.5, 14.5, 19.6, 27, and 39 GeV.

arxiv-2309-02176.title: Kac–Moody Symmetric Spaces: arbitary symmetrizable complex or almost split real type
arxiv-2309-02176.creator: Ralf Köhl, Christian Vock
arxiv-2309-02176.description: Abstract We revisit the theory of Kac–Moody symmetric spaces in order to include the affine case, complex numbers, and Galois descent to almost split real Kac–Moody symmetric spaces. 1 Introduction Kac–Moody groups have been studied extensively since the 1980s, initiated by [ KP85 ] and [ Tit87 ] .

arxiv-2403-02476.title: A Simple Finite-Time Analysis of TD Learning with Linear Function Approximation
arxiv-2403-02476.creator: Aritra Mitra
arxiv-2403-02476.description: Abstract We study the finite-time convergence of TD learning with linear function approximation under Markovian sampling. Existing proofs for this setting either assume a projection step in the algorithm to simplify the analysis, or require a fairly intricate argument to ensure stability of the iterates.

arxiv-2410-23415.title: Optimized Flow Control based on Automatic Differentiation in Compressible Turbulent Channel Flows
arxiv-2410-23415.creator: Wenkang Wang 1 and Xu Chu 2
arxiv-2410-23415.description: Abstract This study presents an automatic differentiation (AD)-based optimization framework for flow control in compressible turbulent channel flows. We developed a fully differentiable boundary condition framework that allows for the precise calculation of gradients with respect to boundary control variables. This facilitates the efficient optimization of flow control methods.

arxiv-2412-11728.title: SECRET: Towards Scalable and Efficient Code Retrieval via Segmented Deep Hashing
arxiv-2412-11728.creator: Wenchao Gu 1, Ensheng Shi 1, Yanlin Wang 2 3, Lun Du 3, Shi Han, Hongyu Zhang, Dongmei Zhang, Michael R. Lyu
arxiv-2412-11728.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Wenchao Gu 1, Ensheng Shi 1, Yanlin Wang 2 3, Lun Du 3, Shi Han, Hongyu Zhang, Dongmei Zhang, Michael R. Lyu. Code retrieval, which retrieves code snippets based on users’ natural language descriptions, is widely used by developers and plays a pivotal role in real-world software development. The advent of deep learning has shifted the retrieval paradigm from lexical-based matching towards leveraging deep learning models to encode source code and queries into vector representations, facilitating code retrieval according to vector similarity.

arxiv-2510-22761.title: Gravitational wave radiation from periodic orbits and quasi-periodic oscillations in Einstein non-linear Maxwell-Yukawa black hole Journal: Journal Name
arxiv-2510-22761.creator: Tehreem Zahra, Oreeda Shabbir, Bushra Majeed, Mubasher Jamil, Javlon Rayimbaev, Abubakir Shermatov
arxiv-2510-22761.description: Abstract In this article, we investigate the orbital dynamics and quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) surrounding a static, spherically symmetric geometry of an Einstein–nonlinear Maxwell–Yukawa (ENMY) black hole (BH). Using the Hamiltonian formalism, we derive equations of motion and analyze the effective potential.

arxiv-2511-06667.title: Rapidly Learning Soft Robot Control via Implicit Time-Stepping
arxiv-2511-06667.creator: Andrew Choi, Dezhong Tong
arxiv-2511-06667.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Andrew Choi, Dezhong Tong. With the explosive growth of rigid-body simulators, policy learning in simulation has become the de facto standard for most rigid morphologies. In contrast, soft robotic simulation frameworks remain scarce and are seldom adopted by the soft robotics community. This gap stems partly from the lack of easy-to-use, general-purpose frameworks and partly from the high computational cost of accurately simulating continuum mechanics, which often renders policy learning infeasible.

openalex-w7214201690.title: Relação entre a reologia do ácido hialurônico em preenchedores dérmicos e algumas complicações estéticas
openalex-w7214201690.creator: Raquel Rezende dos Santos, Maria Antônia Ruela Noia de Oliveira, Taíná Correa Atella

A crescente disponibilidade de produtos com diferentes tecnologias de fabricação exige conhecimento sobre suas propriedades...

pmc-10731137.title: Increased Risk of Tooth Loss in Postmenopausal Women With Prevalent Vertebral Fractures: An Observational Study
pmc-10731137.creator: Akira Taguchi, Tomohiko Urano, Yukio Nakamura, Masataka Shiraki
pmc-10731137.description: The association between prevalent fractures and tooth loss in postmenopausal women remains unclear. Herein, we investigated the association between prevalent vertebral and nonvertebral fractures, the number of teeth present at baseline, and the number of teeth lost during follow‐up in postmenopausal Japanese women. This cross‐sectional study enrolled 843 participants (mean age 68.3 years).

pmc-11338816.title: The contribution of granger causality analysis to our understanding of cardiovascular homeostasis: from cardiovascular and respiratory interactions to central autonomic network control
pmc-11338816.creator: Vincent Pichot, Christophe Corbier, Florian Chouchou
pmc-11338816.description: Homeostatic regulation plays a fundamental role in maintenance of multicellular life. At different scales and in different biological systems, this principle allows a better understanding of biological organization. Consequently, a growing interest in studying cause-effect relations between physiological systems has emerged, such as in the fields of cardiovascular and cardiorespiratory regulations.

pmc-11409501.title: Antifungal activities of Equol against Candida albicans in vitro and in vivo
pmc-11409501.creator: Fen Wang, Jinping Zhang, Qian Zhang, Zhangyong Song, Caiyan Xin
pmc-11409501.description: Candida albicans is an opportunistic fungal pathogen that can cause systemic infections in immunocompromised individuals. Morphological transition and biofilm formation are major virulence factors of C. albicans. Moreover, biofilm enhances resistance to antifungal agents. Therefore, it is urgent to identify new and effective compounds to target the biofilm of C. albicans.

pmc-11442746.title: The association between salivary IL-6 and poor sleep quality assessed using Apple watches in stressed workers in Japan
pmc-11442746.creator: Akihiro Koreki, Mitsuhiro Sado, Yasue Mitsukura, Hisateru Tachimori, Anna Kubota, Yoshiaki Kanamori, Manae Uchibori, Shiyori Usune, Akira Ninomiya, Ryutaro Shirahama, Akihiro Fujimoto, Kanako Inabe, Hiroaki Miyata, Masaru Mimura
pmc-11442746.description: Insomnia is a major concern among stressed workers worldwide. Although stress generally has a detrimental effect on sleep quality, the impact of biological stress, especially the immunological stress response, on sleep quality is not yet fully understood. Stressed workers were recruited through a screening process using a Brief Job Stress Questionnaire. The participants were asked to complete various occupation-related questionnaires.

pmc-13208807.title: Performance Assessment of Microfiltration Membranes for Backwash Water Reuse from Sand Filters
pmc-13208807.creator: Małgorzata Wolska, Małgorzata Kabsch-Korbutowicz, Fausto A. Canales, Javier Carpintero, Halina Urbańska-Kozłowska
pmc-13208807.description: This study assessed the performance of three microfiltration (MF) membrane modules: M1 (spiral, polyvinylidene fluoride), M2 (capillary, polypropylene), and M3 (capillary, α-Alumina) in treating backwash water from utility-scale surface water (SW) and infiltration water (IW) plants, each with a capacity of approximately 100,000 m3/day.

pmc-13217656.title: The stimuli-responsive CRISPR-Cas12a system for modulating the selective aggregation of cell membrane receptors
pmc-13217656.creator: Ya Wang, Yujing Guo, Yamin Xiong, Xinyi Ren, Yunli Zhao, Lulu Song, Leiliang He
pmc-13217656.description: While CRISPR systems exhibit remarkable programmability in the field of nucleic acid editing, their extension to protein engineering faces a fundamental challenge, namely the traditional CRISPR tools lack the design to efficiently convert stimulus signals into the selective clustering of membrane receptors. This study develops a stimulus-responsive membrane-confined CRISPR-Cas12a platform that enhances selective clustering of membrane receptors for functional regulation.

pmc-13359055.title: Reintegration programmes for people with severe mental illnesses released from correctional institutions: systematic review
pmc-13359055.creator: Alexander I. F. Simpson, M. Umer Waqar, Cory Gerritsen, Vito Adamo, Marco Kilada, Margaret Maheandiran, Reena Besa, Roland M. Jones
pmc-13359055.description: BackgroundPeople with severe mental illness (SMI) face significant challenges when reintegrating from correctional facilities back to the community. These include increased recidivism risk, homelessness and mental health deterioration. Although specialised reintegration programmes were developed to address the needs of this vulnerable population, their effectiveness remains unclear owing to mixed findings reported in the literature.

pmc-13382428.title: Availability and public reimbursement of early breast cancer care across European expert centres: a PORTRAIT from an EUSOMA initiative
pmc-13382428.creator: Eduard-Alexandru Bonci, Rosa Di Micco, Lorenza Marotti, Marisa Miraldo, Isabel T Rubio, Giuseppe Curigliano, Maria-Joao Cardoso, the PORTRAIT Study Group
pmc-13382428.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCross-country disparities in access to guideline-recommended early breast cancer care persist across Europe. PORTRAIT is a clinician-reported, cross-sectional access study mapping availability and state reimbursement of key services across the early breast cancer pathway.MethodsA 49-item survey covering diagnostics, pathology and genomics, systemic therapy, surgery, radiotherapy, and supportive care was emailed from June to September 2024 to multidisciplinary teams at one expert breast centre in 42 European countries. Respondents provided a consensus perspective on service availability and reimbursement.

pmc-13557244.title: Primary Nodular Melanomas May Represent Epidermotropic Melanoma Metastases Diagnosed at a Later Stage
pmc-13557244.creator: Félix Khoa Pham, Marie Danset, Olivier Harou, Damien Vasseur, Jonathan Lopez, Luc Thomas
pmc-13557244.description: e dermis and, when associated with a history of melanoma, are readily identified as secondary lesions. However, epidermotropic melanoma metastases (EMM) can mimic PNM, particularly when no previous primary melanoma has been documented [1,2]. We aimed to compare the clinical, histopathological, and molecular features of PNM and EMM to better distinguish between these entities.

pmc-13606382.title: Factors Associated with Healthcare Professionals’ Attitudes Toward Migrant Patients: A Cross-Sectional, Exploratory Study
pmc-13606382.creator: Zülal Soylu Karaca, Miray Akkuş, Hande Başak
pmc-13606382.description: Objective: To determine healthcare professionals’ attitudes toward migrant patients and explore the sociodemographic and migration-related factors associated with these attitudes. Methods: This descriptive, cross-sectional, exploratory study was conducted with 390 healthcare professionals reached through a Facebook-based professional community and subsequently via other social media platforms using snowball sampling.
